Z-E5IUozd7M.scope: 以製造全貌辨認沉積、微影與蝕刻如何反覆建立不同層。
Z-E5IUozd7M.scopeEn: Identify how repeated deposition, lithography and etching construct different layers.
watchFor: 辨認晶圓、晶粒和電晶體的不同尺度。
找出微影形成光阻圖案與蝕刻轉移圖案的差別。
記下影片簡化或省略的量測、清洗與重複工序。
watchForEn: Distinguish wafer, die and transistor scales.
Separate resist pattern formation from pattern transfer by etching.
Note metrology, cleaning and repeated operations simplified or omitted in the animation.
Z-E5IUozd7M.before: 先畫一張「材料增加／材料移除／性質改變／檢查」四欄表，預測各工序放在哪一欄。
Z-E5IUozd7M.beforeEn: Create four columns for material addition, material removal, property change and inspection; predict where each operation belongs.
Z-E5IUozd7M.after: 用自己的圖重建一層圖案的旅程，並解釋為什麼微影機本身不會完成整顆晶片。
Z-E5IUozd7M.afterEn: Redraw the journey of one patterned layer and explain why a lithography machine alone does not manufacture a whole chip.

ST_1krgYni4.afterEn: Explain why better electrostatics alone does not establish resistance or yield.

h_zgURwr6nA.scope: 辨認曝光系統的光學、載台與整合規模；動畫為導覽，不是組裝施工圖。
h_zgURwr6nA.scopeEn: Identify the optics, stages and integration scale of an exposure system; the animation is a tour, not assembly drawings.
watchFor: 找出光罩與晶圓所處的不同位置。
觀察光學系統與精密運動系統如何配合。
把解析度能力與層間對準能力分開記錄。
watchForEn: Locate the distinct positions of mask and wafer.
Observe cooperation between optics and precision motion.
Record resolution capability separately from layer-to-layer alignment.
h_zgURwr6nA.before: 「能印出更小線條」是否自動代表「每一層都準確重疊」？先寫下理由。
h_zgURwr6nA.beforeEn: Does printing smaller lines automatically mean every layer overlaps accurately? Write your reasoning first.
h_zgURwr6nA.after: 為光學、載台、量測各列出一個輸入、一個輸出與一個可能影響曝光的誤差來源。
h_zgURwr6nA.afterEn: For optics, stages and metrology, list one input, one output and one error source that could affect exposure.
